map.输入上下规格限、测量均值 x̄ 与标准差 s，按 Cgk = min(USL−x: Enter the upper and lower specification limits, the measurement mean x_bar and the standard deviation s, and compute the bias-aware capability index by Cgk = min(USL - x_bar, x_bar - LSL) / (3 x s). Used to gauge how far a measurement system is both accurate (unbiased) and precise (low variation).
map.输入上下规格限、测量均值与标准差，求 Cgk。: Enter the upper and lower specification limits, the measurement mean and the standard deviation to get Cgk.
map.：Cgk = min(USL-mean, mean-LSL)/(3*sigma_: : Cgk = min(USL - mean, mean - LSL)/(3*sigma_measure). Example: with the mean off center by 0.002, Cgk falls slightly below Cg.
map.：Cgk=min(8−5.5, 5.5−2)/(3×0.25)=2.5/0.75: : Cgk = min(8 - 5.5, 5.5 - 2)/(3 x 0.25) = 2.5/0.75 = 3.333. The mean 5.5 is exactly centered; with any offset Cgk drops noticeably below Cg.
